title: Installing Node.js
overview: Node.js can be installed on different operating systems using the official installer. Installation provides the Node.js runtime and npm package manager.

title: Node.js Version Management
overview: Different projects may require different Node.js versions. Version managers help developers switch between Node.js versions easily.

title: Creating Your First Node.js Project
overview: A Node.js project starts with creating a project folder and initializing it using npm.

example.title: Initialize Project
example.content:
mkdir my-project
cd my-project
npm init

title: Understanding package.json
overview: The package.json file stores project information, dependencies, scripts, and configuration details.

title: Topic Summary
overview: You learned how to install Node.js, verify installation, create projects, and understand the package.json configuration file.

example.title: Quick Revision
example.content:
✔ Node.js provides runtime.
✔ npm manages packages.
✔ npm init creates projects.
✔ package.json stores project details.
